degree_rationale: The Four Works of the Ambassador: revealing his image, opening firmament-gates, choosing the light, perfecting men of Christ in the vessel of light. Closing executive sequence of the celestial degree.
direction_rationale: Closes celestial-west: the Ambassador's ultimating works are the seal of the celestial dispensation, gates opened, light chosen, men perfected. The setting of the celestial sun.
grand_man_function: Celestial closing — the Ambassador's executive seal upon love's cosmic descent.
title: The Four Works of the Ambassador
